figure.description: Draw a circular conducting loop in the plane of the page. Mark its centre O and a radius from O to the circumference, labelled r = 10 cm. At the circumference end of this radius, draw an outward radial arrow labelled dr/dt = 5 cm s^{-1}. Show a uniform magnetic field perpendicular into the page using several evenly spaced crosses inside and around the loop, labelled B = 0.2 T. No other labels or values.
